findings.current_behavior: AccountUtilityScreen always calls vm.load(mode). For backup and export, the ViewModel requests /api/v1/mobile/account/utilities/backup or /export, but mobileUtilities has neither section and throws INVALID_SECTION. The generic error path can leave an error banner while separate generate/export buttons remain available.
findings.required_correction: Avoid unsupported startup requests for action-only screens, or implement an authorized matching section/DTO. Distinguish startup/load errors from actual generation/delivery errors; cover Web/native screen entry and role denial.
findings.evidence: Synthetic calls to the actual mobileUtilities function rejected backup and export with INVALID_SECTION. Source chain: AccountUtilityScreen.kt:109; AccountUtilityViewModel.kt:27; src/lib/mobile/account-administration.ts:385. API HTTP status/banner rendering inferred from source, not device or live HTTP execution.

findings.classification: Manual reminder distinguishes generation from durable delivery
findings.current_behavior: Record-only manual generation inserts AccountBackupRecord before any download/save/share completes. backupReminderDue accepts provider-less generated records as recent backups, including a generated file later abandoned by the consumer. Therefore a reminder can be postponed without a saved or handed-off copy.
findings.required_correction: Keep generation and delivery states distinct. Base reminder suppression on the explicitly documented durable-save/share confirmation policy. Do not describe an email handoff as confirmed email delivery, or infer a completed browser download from GET generation.
findings.evidence: Actual createAccountBackupForActor synthetic call recorded a bundle without storage writes or a consumer save/share. Given that generated timestamp, actual backupReminderDue returned false. Source utilities.ts:698 and backup-settings.ts:225.

findings.current_behavior: Authentication users are explicitly projected and Google credentials live outside snapshots, but raw operational audit metadata, recycle snapshots and other selected JSON are serialized without recursive sensitive-key exclusion. Synthetic password/apiToken values in an operational audit metadata object survived the generated bundle.
findings.required_correction: Define and enforce the secret-exclusion schema for exported unstructured metadata without destroying required immutable business history. Test nested JSON and recycled/snapshotted values separately from the existing authentication-column exclusion.
findings.evidence: Actual synthetic bundle retained two SYNTHETIC_A112 sensitive-key markers. No real credential or production record was queried, and no existing production leak is asserted. Source utilities.ts:580/634/691. Related A111-F02 has a different consumer (mobile audit history).

findings.classification: Native shared-file lifecycle and repeated actions
findings.current_behavior: Native backup generation has no in-flight guard and delivers a fixed salespunch360-account-backup.json filename. The share handler writes that same cache path before exposing a FileProvider URI; consuming UI state does not retire the cache copy. Repeated requests can replace the bytes associated with an earlier shared path.
findings.required_correction: Give each export/backup delivery a unique private cache file and request identity, guard concurrent generation/delivery and define cleanup after sharing. Keep a successful user-selected phone backup separate from disposable share-cache files.
findings.evidence: Source-only lifecycle review: AccountUtilityViewModel.backup/download and AccountUtilityScreen.kt:117–137. Actual race, FileProvider grant duration, cross-account behavior and physical device cleanup were not exercised. No actual cross-company disclosure is asserted.

verified_existing_controls: Admin-only backup generation rejected a non-admin before snapshot reads in the synthetic probe.
Existing focused tests passed for checksum-protected snapshots, file-inclusive limits/failure, Google state binding and encrypted connection, Drive-only scheduling and confirmed remote delivery.
Native phone-save picker, Web transfer verification and exact four menu entries exist in merged source; real device/browser/provider delivery not certified.
